concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – Cleaning, filtering & exclusion logging (pending / corrected)
concerns.text: Tasks T015b, T015c, and T016 are all tagged `[US1]` but span multiple phases and rely on each other, violating the rule that all tasks within a user‑story block must be independently shippable.

Task T028 computes VIF on raw compositional predictors but reads `data/processed/alloys_clean.parquet`, which is only produced by T015b. Since T015b references undefined predecessor tasks, the data‑flow to T028 is broken.

Task T027a requires the trained model (`models/rf_model.pkl`) and ILR‑transformed data (`data/processed/alloys_ilr.parquet`). The ILR file is produced by T019, which is listed earlier, but T019 itself depends on the missing cleaning tasks, creating an indirect ordering gap.
